title_seed: Writer 寫得出來，不代表能發布
central_problem: Writer 的可讀文字若未通過 claim/citation entailment，誰有權停止正式輸出？
reader_takeaway: Writer 是 evidence consumer，不是 evidence authority。

known_at_the_time.fact: knowledge reconstruction QA 的實際 Ollama run 有 7/7 requested sections，但只有 4 個 model sections，3 個 fallback sections。
post-edit sentence-level claim/citation entailment failure 導致 formal export gate blocked。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: two-pass teach-back → academic reconstruction、writer isolation 與 post-edit verification 已被實際 QA 記錄。

not_yet_available.fact: canonical admission owner、current full-text qualification 與 V5 budget authority 尚未是這個 dated QA 的前提。

observed_failures.symptom: readable generated content failed sentence-level claim/citation entailment
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: generated claim/citation binding did not meet the post-edit verifier
observed_failures.later_resolution: later canonical publication and generalization gates kept the same fail-closed boundary

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The actual dated run produced four model sections and three fallback sections, then failed post-edit validation before formal export.

engineering_decisions.decision: 先做 writer-safe projection 與 post-edit verifier，再允許 formal document/export。

architecture_state.state: canonical facts/claims → isolated Writer passes → sentence/citation verification → export gate

safe_numbers.meaning: actual dated QA run; not a success rate

safe_public_facts.fact: 生成出段落不等於段落已經被證據驗證；失敗時不匯出是一種正確結果。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來更嚴格的 canonical admission 把『Writer 看到了什麼』往前固定，但這一日的核心證據仍是 Writer verification failure。

publication_risks: 不要只報 model section count 而忽略 blocked verdict。
不要公開 raw response 或 internal IDs。
